name: NG exhaustion recursive predictive-memory chain test
purpose: Determine how many successive exhaustion links retain inherited predictive information before the lineage resets, without categorizing chains by their characteristics.
input_sequence: Complete ordered week-continuous exhaustion roster from first detected exhaustion after Sunday reopen through weekly close.

allowed: the 61-sample oriented roll20 exhaustion pre-curve t=-60..0 for each event
the raw exhaustion polarity for each event
membership_features.reason: First-pass chain membership must be driven by inherited exhaustion-state information, not by posthoc chain characteristics.

primary_target: Whether the next detected exhaustion has the same polarity as the current exhaustion.

order_semantics.history_length_1: current exhaustion state predicts the next exhaustion; this is the clean second-order test
order_semantics.history_length_2: previous exhaustion plus current exhaustion predict the next exhaustion; incremental value over length 1 is third-order inherited memory
order_semantics.history_length_h: the oldest event in the h-event history is an ancestor h-1 links behind the current event; incremental predictive value over h-1 measures whether that ancestor still matters for the next transition

cross_week_validation.scheme: leave-one-trading-week-out; train on the other complete weeks and score the held-out week, rotating so every event receives only out-of-week predictions

state_representation.curve_compression: PCA fit on training-week 61-sample pre-curves only; retain the minimum components explaining at least 95% training variance

aggregate_memory_depth.metric: out-of-week log-loss improvement Δ_h = logloss(history h-1) - logloss(history h)
aggregate_memory_depth.continuation_evidence: Δ_h > 0 means the additional ancestor improves prediction on unseen weeks
aggregate_memory_depth.adaptive_extension: If the deepest tested history still has positive pooled out-of-week Δ_h and positive Δ_h in at least two of three held-out weeks, extend depths to 16; repeat to 32 and 64 as needed. If memory remains at the computational cap, report right-censored depth rather than declaring an endpoint.

instance_level_lineage.pointwise_evidence: For an actual next-event outcome, compute inherited pointwise log-score gain g_h = log p_h(actual outcome) - log p_(h-1)(actual outcome).
instance_level_lineage.bootstrap: Within each training fold, resample training events by contiguous within-week blocks and refit the frozen PCA/model pipeline; never resample individual events as IID.
instance_level_lineage.segmentation: Begin with the first exhaustion after weekly reopen as the first origin. Extend the current lineage while inherited links are confirmed. At the first confirmed reset, the current exhaustion becomes the next first-order origin. An uncertain boundary is preserved as uncertain rather than forced into either chain.

secondary_targets_after_membership_freez: price/trade behavior between frozen chain links
